anomalies.description: A man in a white shirt is approached by two individuals on a scooter; as the scooter stops beside him, one passenger leans toward the man and appears to snatch an item (likely from his hand or pocket) while the driver holds the scooter steady. The man reacts with surprise and raises his hands, consistent with a sudden snatch theft. The scooter then begins to move away immediately after contact, indicating a covert snatching without weapon or threat.

original_descriptions.description: A man in a white shirt is approached by two individuals on a scooter; as the scooter stops beside him, one passenger leans toward the man and appears to snatch an item (likely from his hand or pocket) while the driver holds the scooter steady. A man on a motorcycle (passenger in light-colored clothing) appears to snatch an item (likely a bag or phone) from the person standing by the silver car's open door (wearing white shirt and black backpack), who is distracted. The passenger reaches out abruptly toward the victim’s side, then immediately retracts his arm as the driver starts moving the motorcycle forward—consistent with a snatch theft. The victim reacts by turning and gesturing, indicating surprise and loss. No weapon is visible; the act is swift and covert, matching the 'snatching from a distracted person' anomaly type.

A man in a blue jacket (center) appears to snatch an item—likely a bag or phone—from the person in white (left) who is distracted near the silver car's open door. The victim reacts by turning and reaching out as the perpetrator immediately mounts a motorcycle with an accomplice and flees. This matches the 'snatching from a distracted person, then fleeing' pattern with no weapon or threat, consistent with covert theft.

The scooter then begins to move away immediately after contact, indicating a covert snatching without weapon or threat.
